description: Recreates the approved sample through per-glyph scale, rotation, baseline and spacing changes.
rhythmRules: Do not give adjacent glyphs the same scale and rotation direction.
Choose one or two hero glyphs per line and enlarge them by 12 to 25 percent.
Let one selected long stroke visually push into the next glyph's spacing.
Keep at least one quieter glyph between two high-energy glyphs.
Punctuation may shrink and sink below the baseline.
